_comment: Structural regression ceilings for the scenarios in perf/PerfBenchmark.cs.
All three are measured: node_count max 1812 (solo-default), 2823 (visual-worst),
and 1410 (endless-road) in artifacts/performance/current on 2026-09-20, plus about
10% margin. The earlier seeded ceilings came from the 2026-07-26 captures and were
loose by roughly 30% once the batching work landed.
Node counts are gated because they are structural and stable: solo-default held
exactly 1812 across a whole run, while frame times and draw calls vary with the
GPU, the driver, and host contention, as the accompanying report notes.
Update a ceiling deliberately, in the same change that justifies the new cost.
